intro: Jaipur has five zones on NXTutors, set around the walled city. C-Scheme and Civil Lines mix apartment buildings and bungalows with offices, while Bani Park and Vidhyadhar Nagar to the north are mostly independent houses, the latter in numbered sectors. East and south-east, Raja Park, Jawahar Nagar and Bapu Nagar are established houses and builder floors where visits rarely involve a gate desk. West Jaipur, from Vaishali Nagar to Ajmer Road, adds gated communities and larger townships, Mansarovar and Pratap Nagar are planned schemes with housing board flats, and the Malviya Nagar, Jagatpura and Tonk Road belt leans to apartments in gated complexes.

Jaipur's only working metro is the Pink Line, which runs from Mansarovar along New Sanganer Road and Hawa Sadak to Civil Lines, Railway Station and Sindhi Camp. That helps in the west and south-west, but the north, the Raja Park side and the Tonk Road belt depend on roads, and the planned Orange Line is still under construction. Most tutors therefore travel by scooter, auto or car. Gopalpura Bypass stays busy with coaching crowds through the day, Ajmer Road and the 200 Feet Bypass are heavy in the evening, market roads in Raja Park and Malviya Nagar fill after dark, and crossing Tonk Road at peak hours is slow.

Jaipur families study under four broad systems: CBSE, the Board of Secondary Education, Rajasthan (RBSE), CISCE's ICSE and ISC, and, in a smaller group, the IB or Cambridge IGCSE. For RBSE students the medium is part of the request, so state whether you teach in Hindi, English or both. Address detail matters here, because sector and scheme numbers repeat across Vidhyadhar Nagar, Jawahar Nagar, Chitrakoot and Mansarovar. Online teaching lets a tutor anywhere in India take Jaipur students, which matters most for IB, IGCSE and senior specialist papers, and it helps on exam weeks when a cross-city trip is hard to fit.

zone_notes.C-Scheme, Bani Park & Vidhyadhar Nagar: C-Scheme apartment buildings want your name and lesson time with security, while Bani Park and Vidhyadhar Nagar houses are doorstep visits; always get the sector number for Vidhyadhar Nagar. Only the southern edge has Pink Line stations, parking in C-Scheme is scarce in office hours, and roads near the station fill in the evening.
zone_notes.Raja Park, Jawahar Nagar & Bapu Nagar: Most homes are houses or builder floors, so there is rarely a gate desk, but ask for the Jawahar Nagar sector or an inner-lane landmark in Raja Park and Bajaj Nagar. No metro station lies inside this zone and market roads crowd in the evening, so a tutor who already lives here, with a spot to park a two-wheeler, has the easier week.
zone_notes.Vaishali Nagar & West Jaipur: Pink Line stations at Mansarovar, Shyam Nagar, Vivek Vihar, Ram Nagar and Civil Lines help tutors reach Nirman Nagar, Shyam Nagar and Sodala, but Vaishali Nagar and Chitrakoot have none. Always get the sector with a Chitrakoot address, register at the gate of Vaishali Nagar gated communities, and leave slack for Ajmer Road in the evening.
zone_notes.Mansarovar & Sanganer: Housing board blocks in Mansarovar and Pratap Nagar are usually doorstep visits, but similar addresses repeat, so ask for the scheme or sector as well as the flat. The Pink Line starts at Mansarovar, Gopalpura Bypass is crowded with coaching students through the day, and Sanganer's older lanes are easier on a two-wheeler.
zone_notes.Malviya Nagar, Jagatpura & Tonk Road: There is no metro here yet, only Durgapura, Getor Jagatpura and Gandhinagar railway stations, so most tutors come by scooter or car. Jagatpura's gated complexes register you at the gate with tower and flat, crossing Tonk Road at peak hours is slow, and Malviya Nagar's market roads fill in the evening, so earlier slots straight after school work well.

boards: Jaipur tutors teach RBSE, CBSE, CISCE's ICSE and ISC, and for a smaller group the IB or Cambridge IGCSE. RBSE, the Board of Secondary Education, Rajasthan, was set up in Jaipur in 1957 and has worked from Ajmer since 1961; it runs the Secondary exam after Class 10 and the Senior Secondary exam after Class 12, and its Class 10 papers carry 80 marks plus 20 sessional marks from school. Read the current syllabus and prospectus on rajeduboard.rajasthan.gov.in, CBSE material on cbseacademic.nic.in and CISCE documents on cisce.org.
faqs: How do Jaipur requests come to a tutor?

A Jaipur parent sends the class, board and medium, subjects, colony with its sector or scheme, and free hours. NXTutors shortlists two or three tutors: those in that colony first, then those who travel there, then the zone, Jaipur and online. Your fee is visible to the family on the shortlist before the free first demo.
Can I teach online as a Jaipur tutor?

Yes. Turn on online lessons and requests reach you by subject, board, class and free hours, whatever city the family is in. An RBSE tutor who teaches in Hindi and English, for instance, can take online students across Rajasthan alongside home classes in the colonies near home.
Which Jaipur colonies should I add as travel areas?

Add your own zone, then any colony you can reach without crossing Tonk Road or the Ajmer Road corridor at peak hour. If you live near a Pink Line station, the stretch from Mansarovar to Civil Lines opens up. Give each colony a fair test: you must reach it on time every week.
Is police verification needed to teach on NXTutors?

No. Tutors who join complete an ID check, not a police check: a one-time code confirms your phone or email, then you upload a government photo ID, which our team reviews before your profile goes live. Real tutors who pass show a Verified badge. How we verify tutors (/how-we-verify-tutors) explains the process.
Are tutor plans free in Jaipur?

No. Tutor plans are paid, and what each one includes is on the Pricing page (/pricing). Your lesson fee is up to you, and Jaipur families see it before booking the free demo. Parents may switch tutor without paying anything, so a tutor who keeps the agreed time every week is the one families hold on to.
